item.title: ULA: Vulcan Anomaly Caused by Fuel Supply, Not Engine
item.description: ULA confirms the Vulcan rocket’s Leo 1 launch anomaly stemmed from insufficient fuel to Blue Origin’s BE‑4 engines, not engine performance overall.
